docs.title: Development of simple Flexray Driver
docs.text:
2021 — Daimler Central Gateway Project

Tags: FlexRay, Embedded C, Interrupt/Polling, CEIC

Implemented an optimized Flexray Driver for driving one specific Flexray controller, enabling only one channel with a limited number of configured frames This was needed to enable Flexray communication in a particular project with as minimal memory footprint as possible with as fast run-time as possible This bare metal Flexray driver did not follow AUTOSAR standards, dint implement all AUTOSAR APIs, dint use joblist or interrupts and is not reusable as-is in other projects (That's the way it was intended to be developed)
